latents.fact: something is developing in one of the trays — it hasn't finished yet, but the shape is already there, already arrived before it's visible
the red light here makes everything look like it's held just before a decision — every object at the moment before it becomes what it is
a strip of negatives hangs from a line near the ceiling — held up to the safelight, the images are inverted: white skies, dark faces, a world that had to be reversed to be preserved
latents.item_desc: Everything inverted. The only way to carry the image was to carry it wrong-side-out.

latents.fact: on the back of the door, someone has written in small letters: 'the image was already there. the chemicals just had to admit it.'

listen_latents: the chemical trays make almost no sound — just the faint shift of liquid when the building breathes
somewhere, a timer is counting down, but you cannot see it — only hear it
